headline: matu997 closes on ARC-2 gold places

sections.text: matu997 gained 9.73 points to reach 64.31, climbing from 22nd to 17th on the public ARC-2 board.
The team now sits 0.41 behind the gold line. The last of the 16 gold places stands at 64.72.
